`final class BoundingBox`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.geom` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BoundingBox.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/geom/BoundingBox.java)

Mutable rectangle stored by its minimum and maximum corners, in design pixels.

## Description

`expand(...)` and `contract(...)` change this box; `copy()` first to keep the original.
